title: Amakuru yawe yo kwivuza, ahantu hamwe
synthetic: Ibiri hano byose ni amakuru y'igerageza. Si amakuru nyayo y'ubuzima bwawe.
syntheticNotForMedicalUse: Ibiri hano byose ni amakuru y'igerageza. Si amakuru nyayo y'ubuzima bwawe kandi ntakoreshwa mu kwivuza.
subtitle: Reba ibisubizo n'intambwe zikurikira itsinda rikuvura ryagusangije.

about.title: Ibyerekeye iri gerageza
about.showsBody: Ibisubizo n'intambwe zikurikira itsinda rikuvura ryasuzumye rikabikugezaho gusa.
about.neverBody: Ntijya isuzuma indwara cyangwa itanga inama zo kwivuza, ntijya yerekana amanota y'ubuzima, kandi ntijya ikoreshwa mu bwishingizi cyangwa mu nguzanyo.
about.contactBody: Ku bibazo bijyanye no kwivuza kwawe, vugana n'itsinda rikuvura ku kigo nderabuzima. Mu gihe cy'ibyihutirwa, jya ku kigo nderabuzima kikwegereye.

persona.title: Hitamo umuntu w'igerageza
persona.intro: Buri muntu w'igerageza ni uw'ibihimbano werekana uko ibintu bimeze muri porogaramu.
persona.disclaimer: Umuntu w'igerageza — guhindura uruhare si ukwinjira nyakuri
persona.emptyBody: Amakuru y'igerageza ashobora kuba yabuze. Ongera utangire igerageza kugira ngo agaruke.
persona.startError: Uyu muntu ntiyashoboye gufungurwa. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.

verify.title: Emeza ko ari wowe
verify.intro: Andika kode y'imibare 6 kugira ngo urangize gutegura porogaramu yawe.
verify.hintBody: Muri iri gerageza kode ni {{code}}. Iri ni igenzura ry'igerageza — ntiryemeza umwirondoro nyakuri w'umuntu.
verify.wrongCode: Iyo kode si yo. Usigaje kugerageza inshuro {{count}}.
verify.unavailable: Serivisi yo kwemeza ntiboneka ubu. Nta cyahindutse. Uzongere ugerageze nyuma.
verify.error: Kode ntiyashoboye kugenzurwa. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.

recover.title: Shaka ubufasha ku kigo nderabuzima
recover.body: Kode zitari zo zinjijwe inshuro nyinshi, bityo iyi porogaramu yafunzwe. Itsinda rikuvura rishobora kuyifungura no kwemeza uwo uri imbonankubone ku kigo nderabuzima.
recover.contactBody: Ahakirirwa abantu, Ikigo nderabuzima cy'igerageza Alpha — gifungura iminsi y'akazi 07:00–17:00.

header.switchPersonaHint: Isoza iki gice cy'igerageza igasubira ku rutonde rw'abantu.
